Keratosis pilaris

Keratosis pilaris is a very common skin condition which affects children and teenagers more than adults. It causes rough skin, particularly over the upper arms, outer legs and buttocks.

Swollen eyelid

A swollen eyelid is very common and is usually due to allergy, inflammation, infection, or injury. It can affect either the upper or lower eyelid, or both.
